note: Re-judged 2026-11-25 by an independent agent after commit 1f82b2727d reworded comments in xfrmStateFromParams (netlink to netlink library); vpp.go::InstallSA and vpp.go::vppSAFlags were untouched. RFC 4303 Section 3.4.4.1: "If the default padding scheme (see Section 2.4) has been employed, the receiver SHOULD inspect the Padding field before removing the padding prior to passing the decrypted data to the next layer." Neither xfrmStateFromParams nor vpp.go requests padding inspection or decrypts ESP, and nothing in the tree shows Linux XFRM or VPP inspecting the Padding bytes on the installed state, so the {gap} annotation is accurate and the requirement stays unmet.
